stop: Stay on safe ground. If an immediate hazard threatens the spot, move only by a clearly safer route.
If a CO alarm sounds or exposure is suspected, get everyone to fresh outdoor air immediately and call 911 from outside. Leave equipment untouched during evacuation.
Call U.S. Poison Control at 1-800-222-1222 promptly after a suspected ingestion. Call 911 for collapse, seizure, trouble breathing or inability to wake.
